resources.string: Resumo de Notificacións con IA proporciona resumos intelixentes da información clave das notificacións. Xiaomi necesita acceder e procesar o contido das notificacións para proporcionar esta característica, pero Xiaomi non almacenará esta información.

"Obtén resumos intelixentes para as notificacións amosadas na lista de vista previa para unha referencia sinxela. O contido dos resumos, incluíndo calquera información privada que conteñan, será procesado por Xiaomi, pero non almacenaremos estes datos."

Para saber se varias personas están mirando a pantalla, esta función accederá á cámara frontal cando se amose unha notificación flotante. As imaxes recompiladas só se utilizan para a análise no dispositivo da cantidade de persoas que miran a pantalla. Cando se detectan varias personas, o contenido da notificación ocultarase de forma predeterminada.

Cando esta función estea activada, a cámara frontal comprobará quen está mirando a pantalla cando chegue unha notificación. Se o teléfono detecta que non es o único que está vendo a pantalla, ocultará automaticamente o contido da notificación. Todos os datos das imaxes e faciais procesaranse localmente no teu dispositivo e nunca se subirán á nube.

Settings for managing whether each app can send notifications, covering per-app control, sorting by time received, and access to each app notification settings page.

Settings for a specific app notifications, covering whether it can send notifications, Xiaomi HyperIsland, badges, floating and lock screen notifications, sound, vibration, and permanent notifications.
Settings page for notification badges, where users can manage on a per-app basis whether notification badges are allowed.

App notification badge permission switch. JSON object where keys are app package names and values are true (enabled) or false (disabled). This permission depends on app notification permission being enabled.
App notification badge switch. Requires app notification permission to be enabled before modification.
Settings for floating notifications, covering the Hide temporarily rule and per-app control over whether floating notifications are allowed.

App floating notification permission switch. JSON object where keys are app package names and values are true (enabled) or false (disabled). This permission depends on app notification permission being enabled.
App floating notification switch. Requires app notification permission to be enabled before modification.

App lock screen notification permission switch. JSON object where keys are app package names and values are true (enabled) or false (disabled). This permission depends on app notification permission being enabled.
App lock screen notification switch. Requires app notification permission to be enabled before modification.
Settings for lock screen notifications, covering the display style (List, Stack, or Number), format, and per-app control over whether lock screen notifications are allowed.

App permanent notification permission switch. JSON object where keys are app package names and values are true (enabled) or false (disabled). This permission depends on app notification permission being enabled.
App persistent notification switch. Requires app notification permission to be enabled before modification.
App notification permission switch. JSON object where keys are app package names and values are true (allow notifications) or false (block notifications).
App notification permission switch. Not writable on international builds due to privacy policy restrictions; writable on domestic builds.Only one app can be modified at a time.

App notification sound permission switch. JSON object where keys are app package names and values are true (enabled) or false (disabled). This permission depends on app notification permission being enabled.
App notification sound switch. Requires app notification permission to be enabled before modification.

App Xiaomi HyperIsland permission switch. JSON object where keys are app package names and values are true (enabled), false (disabled), or not_supported (does not support Xiaomi HyperIsland). This permission depends on app notification permission being enabled.
App notification Xiaomi HyperIsland switch. Requires app notification permission to be enabled before modification.

Global settings for notifications, status bar, and control center, covering Xiaomi HyperIsland, lock screen and floating notifications, badges, app notifications, carrier display, and battery indicator.

App notification vibration permission switch. JSON object where keys are app package names and values are true (enabled) or false (disabled). This permission depends on app notification permission being enabled.
App notification vibration switch. Requires app notification permission to be enabled before modification.
